title_trans.en-us: POP MART Launches First Permanent POP BAKERY Store in Aranya

description_trans.en-us: New shop by the sea brings beloved IP characters to life with artisanal desserts.

items.note: POP MART Launches First Permanent POP BAKERY Store

content.en-us:
BEIJING, June 19, 2026 — POP MART (09992.HK) today opened its first permanent POP BAKERY store at Aranya, the popular vacation resort in Hebei province, northern China, marking a new chapter for the brand's dessert venture.

Founder and CEO of POP MART, Wang Ning, will unveil the seaside store with Ma Yin, founder and CEO of Aranya, in front of the mega TWINKLE TWINKLE statue on the beachfront.

POP BAKERY offers sweets and beverages inspired by POP MART's iconic characters. The signature bakery lineup includes CRYBABY, TWINKLE TWINKLE and SKULLPANDA ice cream, DIMOO and LABUBU butter cookies and cakes, and MOLLY chocolate—offering fans a delicious new way to experience their favorite IP characters. The soft opening on Wednesday had already welcomed hundreds of visitors before the Dragon Boat Festival holiday weekend.

POP BAKERY first became popular as part of POP LAND's attractions in Beijing in 2024. Since then,  POP BAKERY pop-up shops have served fans in 21 locations across China, including Qingdao, Chengdu, Nanjing, Xi'an, Shenzhen, Wuhan, Chongqing, and more.

Aranya Store Highlights

• Location: Phase 6 Cultural & Creative District, North Station East

• Hours: 10:00 AM – 10:00 PM

• Specials: TWINKLE TWINKLE Tea Party, an afternoon tea set (limited to 70 daily reservations) and limited-edition Dragon Boat Festival SKULLPANDA gift boxes.

POP BAKERY joins POP MART's growing lifestyle ecosystem alongside the POP LAND theme park, bringing joy to fans beyond the collectible shelf.
